name: Azumi Kousuke
source:
Kousuke failed to enter collage so he is forced to attend summer camp along with his sister, her classmate
Segawa Izumi, her senpai Ebihara Marina, and his former homeroom teacher Shiraishi Satsuki who was his first love.
